title: Theatre Kids 🤝 Iconic Movie Songs (Thank You @Josh Groban) #moviesoun...
transcript: Josh Groban truly is the ultimate fanboy and it's what I love so much about him. He's one of the most talented singers on the planet. He could do anything he wants. And what he chooses to do is consistently uplift art that inspires him. Like this man was doing Broadway covers before it was cool. And today, Josh Groban announced his new album Cinematic which is just another proof of his fanboy status because he is celebrating iconic movie songs that inspire him. This is a 10 track album. We're talking ‘As Time Goes By’ from Casablanca, ‘Moon River’ from Breakfast at Tiffany’s Jennifer Hudson is also going to be featured on ‘Unchained Melody’ from Ghost. I love it. His first single which is out today, ‘Can You Feel The Love Tonight.’ Obviously I had to listen. Nobody sings like Josh Groban. You can listen to ‘Can You Feel the Love Tonight’ right now and the full album is out May 8th.
